text_en: He made the altar of burnt offering also of acacia wood; it was five cubits long, and five cubits wide; it was square, and three cubits high.
text_cn: 用皂荚木做了全燔祭坛，长五肘，宽五肘，方形，高三肘。

text_en: He made horns for it on its four corners; its horns were of one piece with it, and he overlaid it with bronze.
text_cn: 在祭坛四角上做了四翘角，四翘角由祭坛突出；祭坛包上了铜。

text_en: He made all the utensils of the altar, the pots, the shovels, the basins, the forks, and the firepans: all its utensils he made of bronze.
text_cn: 以后做了祭坛的一切用具：盆、铲、盘、肉叉和火盆：这一切用具是铜做的。

text_en: He made for the altar a grating, a network of bronze, under its ledge, extending halfway down.
text_cn: 为祭坛做了一架铜格子，好像网的制法，安在祭坛下方的围腰下，直到祭坛半腰。

text_en: He cast four rings on the four corners of the bronze grating to hold the poles;
text_cn: 又铸了四个环子，安在铜格子的四角上，为穿杠杆用。

text_en: he made the poles of acacia wood, and overlaid them with bronze.
text_cn: 用皂荚木做了杠杆，包了铜。

text_en: And he put the poles through the rings on the sides of the altar, to carry it with them; he made it hollow, with boards.
text_cn: 把杠杆穿入祭坛两侧的环子内，好抬祭坛；祭坛是用木板做的，中心是空的。

text_en: He made the basin of bronze with its stand of bronze, from the mirrors of the women who served at the entrance to the tent of meeting.
text_cn: 又用在会幕门口服务的妇女所用的铜镜，做了铜盆以及盆座。

text_en: He made the court; for the south side the hangings of the court were of fine twisted linen, one hundred cubits long;
text_cn: 筑了庭院：为向阳的一面，即南面，用捻的细麻做了帷幔，共一百肘，

text_en: its twenty pillars and their twenty bases were of bronze, but the hooks of the pillars and their bands were of silver.
text_cn: 柱子二十根，铜卯（mǎo）座二十个；柱钩和横棍是银的。

text_en: For the north side there were hangings one hundred cubits long; its twenty pillars and their twenty bases were of bronze, but the hooks of the pillars and their bands were of silver.
text_cn: 北面的帷幔也是一百肘，柱子二十根，铜卯（mǎo）座二十个；柱钩和横棍是银的。

text_en: For the west side there were hangings fifty cubits long, with ten pillars and ten bases; the hooks of the pillars and their bands were of silver.
text_cn: 西面的帷幔共五十肘，柱子十根，卯（mǎo）座十个；柱钩和横棍是银的。

text_en: And for the front to the east, fifty cubits.
text_cn: 前面，即东面，共五十肘；

text_en: The hangings for one side of the gate were fifteen cubits, with three pillars and three bases.
text_cn: 这边的帷幔十五肘，柱子三根，卯（mǎo）座三个；

text_en: And so for the other side; on each side of the gate of the court were hangings of fifteen cubits, with three pillars and three bases.
text_cn: 那边也是如此。庭院门口的两边，皆有帷幔十五肘，柱子三根，卯（mǎo）座三个。

text_en: All the hangings around the court were of fine twisted linen.
text_cn: 庭院四周所有的帷幔，都是用捻的细麻编成的。

text_en: The bases for the pillars were of bronze, but the hooks of the pillars and their bands were of silver; the overlaying of their capitals was also of silver, and all the pillars of the court were banded with silver.
text_cn: 柱的卯（mǎo）座是铜的，柱钩和横棍是银的，柱帽包上了银；庭院所有的柱子都用银横棍连贯起来。

text_en: The screen for the entrance to the court was embroidered with needlework in blue, purple, and crimson yarns and fine twisted linen. It was twenty cubits long and, along the width of it, five cubits high, corresponding to the hangings of the court.
text_cn: 庭院的门帘是用紫色、红色、朱红色的毛线和捻的细麻编成的，宽二十肘，高五肘，与庭院的帷幔高度相等。

text_en: There were four pillars; their four bases were of bronze, their hooks of silver, and the overlaying of their capitals and their bands of silver.
text_cn: 门帘的柱子四根，铜卯（mǎo）座四个，银柱钩；柱帽包上了银，横棍是银的。

text_en: All the pegs for the tabernacle and for the court all around were of bronze.
text_cn: 帐棚和庭院的一切橛子是铜的。

text_en: These are the records of the tabernacle, the tabernacle of the covenant, which were drawn up at the commandment of Moses, the work of the Levites being under the direction of Ithamar son of the priest Aaron.
text_cn: 以下是为立帐棚即会幕的总账，是照梅瑟的命令，肋未人在司祭亚郎的儿子依塔玛尔指导下所计算的：──

text_en: Bezalel son of Uri son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah, made all that the Lord commanded Moses;
text_cn: 犹大支派乌黎的儿子，胡尔的孙子贝匝肋耳完成了上主吩咐梅瑟的一切；

text_en: and with him was Oholiab son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan, engraver, designer, and embroiderer in blue, purple, and crimson yarns, and in fine linen.
text_cn: 与他同事的有丹支派阿希撒玛客的儿子敖曷里雅布，他会雕刻，会设计，会用紫色、红色、朱红色的毛线和细麻织绣。

text_en: All the gold that was used for the work, in all the construction of the sanctuary, the gold from the offering, was twenty-nine talents and seven hundred thirty shekels, measured by the sanctuary shekel.
text_cn: 为建造圣所整个工程所使用的金子，即献的金子，按圣所的衡量，共计二十九"塔冷通"零七百三十"协刻耳"。

text_en: The silver from those of the congregation who were counted was one hundred talents and one thousand seven hundred seventy-five shekels, measured by the sanctuary shekel;
text_cn: 会众登记者所缴纳的银子，按圣所的衡量，共计一百"塔冷通”零一千七百七十五“协刻耳”。

text_en: a beka a head (that is, half a shekel, measured by the sanctuary shekel), for everyone who was counted in the census, from twenty years old and upward, for six hundred three thousand, five hundred fifty men.
text_cn: 凡二十岁以上来登记的，共六十万三千五百五十人；每人缴纳一"贝卡"，按圣所的衡量，合半"协刻耳"。

text_en: The hundred talents of silver were for casting the bases of the sanctuary, and the bases of the curtain; one hundred bases for the hundred talents, a talent for a base.
text_cn: 为铸圣所的卯（mǎo）座和门帘的卯（mǎo）座，用了一百"塔冷通"银子：一百卯（mǎo）座，用一百"塔冷通"银子，一"塔冷通"铸一卯（mǎo）座。

text_en: Of the thousand seven hundred seventy-five shekels he made hooks for the pillars, and overlaid their capitals and made bands for them.
text_cn: 用那一千七百七十五"协刻耳"银子做了柱钩，包了柱帽，并做了接连柱子的横棍。

text_en: The bronze that was contributed was seventy talents, and two thousand four hundred shekels;
text_cn: 所奉献的铜，共计七十"塔冷通"零二千四百"协刻耳"。

text_en: with it he made the bases for the entrance of the tent of meeting, the bronze altar and the bronze grating for it and all the utensils of the altar,
text_cn: 用此铜做了会幕门口的卯（mǎo）座、铜坛和坛下的铜格子，并坛的一切用具，

text_en: the bases all around the court, and the bases of the gate of the court, all the pegs of the tabernacle, and all the pegs around the court.
text_cn: 庭院四周的卯（mǎo）座，庭院门口的卯（mǎo）座，帐棚所有的橛子，以及庭院四周所有的橛子。
